ADANI ENERGY SOLUTIONS WINS BIHAR TRANSMISSION PROJECT

Adani Energy Solutions has been awarded a transmission project in Bihar for a 2,400 MW thermal power plant. The work will strengthen the state’s transmission network and improve reliability of power supply. The contract adds to Adani Energy Solutions’ transmission capex, taking it to ₹91,500 crore, and highlights growing investment in India’s power grid infrastructure.

For information only. Not investment advice.
